scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,vite,gen -c green,blue,yellow "npm run dev:server" "vite" "npm run gen:watch"
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n fable-server,wrangler -c green,yellow "npm run fable:watch:server" "wrangler dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:admin && npm run build:server && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: vite build && mkdir -p _site${BASE_PATH} && cp -r public/* _site${BASE_PATH}/ && { [ -z "${BASE_PATH}" ] || cp _site${BASE_PATH}/index.html _site/index.html; }
scripts.deploy: SITE_SLUG=ntnews SITE_TITLE="Nuclear Territory News" ADMIN_TITLE="ntne.ws admin" npm run build && wrangler deploy
